The '''Imperial implantation lab''' was a laboratory operated by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in the [[Network Security District]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Located on [[Infotech Plaza]], the lab was tasked with implanting cranial explosives in prisoners of the Empire's [[Shadow Town]] complex, and thus was destroyed by Republic forces.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial implantation lab appears as part of the Republic mission "Elective Surgery" on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
